data.name: Step through Shadows
data.description: If you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can travel to another location of dim light or darkness as if by means of fold space, as long as the destination is within %1 ft. of your initial location.  Using this ability counts as a daily use of the terrors ability.|StepThroughShadowsRange
